title: Zink Atas Kepala
subject: two old friends replacing the rusted zinc roof sheets of a kampung house on one Saturday, one on the roof counting screws, the other on the ladder passing sheets up
caption: Malay surf rock in the 1960s instrumental-band revival style. Twangy lead guitar soaked in spring reverb playing tremolo-picked runs, chugging rhythm guitar, Farfisa organ swells, walking electric bass, driving drums with crashing ride. Vintage live-room feel. Male lead with a bright mid tenor, clearly sung, band gang vocals on the chorus. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 152 BPM, E major. Sun-baked weekend hard work. No distorted metal guitar, no autotune, no trap drums, no rap, no synth pads.
lyrics:
[Intro - surf guitar run, drum fill]
[Verse 1]
Zink lama dah bocor macam ayak
Sabtu pagi Mamat dah panjat
Aku pegang tangga, kaki terketar
Dia jerit, hulur kepingan lagi
[Chorus]
Zink atas kepala, matahari tegak
Skru dalam mulut, tukul berdetak
Satu keping lagi, satu keping lagi
Sebelum Zohor kita turun
[Verse 2]
Mamat kira skru, tersalah kira
Satu jatuh masuk longkang
Kami cari sampai sakit pinggang
Jumpa dalam selipar dia
[Chorus]
Zink atas kepala, peluh menitik
Mamat menyanyi lagu lama
Satu keping lagi, satu keping lagi
Sebelum Asar kita turun
[Bridge - guitar solo]
[Outro - organ and guitar, gang vocals]
Malam nanti hujan pun boleh
Kami dengar bunyi dia dari dalam
